protocol.candidate_pool: All 12 previously qualified minimum plans, from frozen full 175-plan pool; retain unrestricted parallel reference
protocol.config_source: Unmodified experiments/ablation.py::compile_kwargs; case grover_public_development, no consumable tags
protocol.primary_target: All 2 original terminal classical bits; complete rank-2 literal physical-record basis
protocol.scope: Native compiler reference, not the same gate-preserving routing/template/budget experiment
protocol.noise: CircLS inject_uniform_noise, distinct model ID from existing TQEC add_noise; no cross-model LER comparison
protocol.decoder: ordinary uncorrelated PyMatching MWPM construction on complete 2-output annotated view; no sampling
protocol.source_policy: Every original H/X/CX/readout supplied once, same full unitary before native lowering; only existing common-end terminal-readout deferral
protocol.physical_validation: Exact reference trajectory, deterministic DEM, full output signs and final physical-X readout response; no verify()/sampler API
protocol.stop_rule: Compile both configs for all 12, plus 3 nonzero signed input probes per config. Report collapse/inadmissibility rather than claim speed or LER improvement.
